goal:
T30 — persist evolutions and evolution memory in PostgreSQL so they survive API redeploys (board W14).

Today services/api/evoforge/evolution.py keeps evolutions in `_evolutions` and memory.py keeps patterns in `_patterns`
(process memory): every deploy erases the autopilot history, its learned patterns and the leaderboard built on them.
Follow the existing pattern exactly: services/api/evoforge/missions.py switches to postgres_missions.MissionStore when
postgres_state.backend() is configured (EVO_STATE_BACKEND=postgres); memory mode stays unchanged.

1. NEW services/api/migrations/012_evolutions.sql, modelled on 006_api_missions.sql: tables
   runtime.api_evolutions (tenant_id, project_id, evolution_id, document jsonb, updated_at; PK tenant/project/id) and
   runtime.api_evolution_memory (tenant_id, project_id, pattern_id/evolution_id, document jsonb, recorded_at), both with
   ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and the same tenant/project policy shape as the other runtime tables, REVOKE ALL FROM
   PUBLIC, GRANT only what core_app needs (evolutions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE; memory: SELECT, INSERT). Wrap in
   BEGIN/COMMIT with SET LOCAL ROLE ctx_owner like 011. Additive only.
2. NEW services/api/evoforge/postgres_evolutions.py: a store scoped to the configured tenant/project (same kernel and
   scope helpers as postgres_missions/postgres_performance) with get/list/upsert for evolutions and record/list for
   memory patterns. Documents are JSON; reject non-finite data with KernelRejected.
3. evolution.py and memory.py: when the postgres backend is configured, every read goes to the store (no stale cache
   across processes) and every mutation (start, record_generation, cancel, memory record) is written through; reset()
   raises KernelRejected for the durable store (like missions). Keep the per-evolution lock and all public function
   signatures and return shapes unchanged. Memory mode behaviour must not change.
4. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t30.py (memory-mode unit tests) and live-PG tests that use the
   test_postgres_kernel fixtures (`database`, `funded`) like tests/test_performance_persistence_pg.py.
Do not change main.py endpoints, patch.py, sealed_eval.py or the web.
